decisions.name: Three exact cross-category copies
decisions.reason: The CWSRF funding proposal, Certified Operator Response Form and Wexford Landfill flow-rate worksheet exactly match records already preserved in other catalogs. They remain reachable through site-wide search and are not republished here.

decisions.name: Three filenames ending ~2
decisions.reason: Content, rendering and hashes show these county-minute files are distinct records, not duplicate copies. The ambiguous source suffix is removed from their displayed names.

decisions.name: Process-flow drawing series and compiled map packages
decisions.reason: Individual engineering sheets and compiled history/map packages have distinct page sequences and evidentiary roles, so each is retained once.

decisions.name: Three low-text map and aerial pages
decisions.reason: Visual inspection confirmed that the pages are intact topographic maps and aerial imagery. They are not failed OCR or corrupt files.

decisions.name: Four August 31 matching-source files
decisions.reason: The supplied brochure and three process-flow PDFs have different container hashes but pixel-identical page sequences to four established records at both 72 and 144 DPI. Their exact supplied bytes and filenames are preserved as searchable matching-source links on the canonical cards. The drawings identify the 2007 improvements in their title blocks, and the brochure does not state a 2017 issue date, so no second evidence record or 2017 chronology event was created.

decisions.name: Undated brochure
decisions.reason: The PDF creation timestamp is preserved in the audit metadata but is not treated as the brochure's publication date because no issue date is printed in the record.

decisions.name: 2025–2026 wastewater asset-management report
decisions.reason: The three-page July 2026 report has a distinct hash and content sequence. It is retained separately from the July 24 MiWaters submission because the report contains the underlying activity, inventory and financial figures while the portal record preserves submission history and attachment context.
